The back-up record belongs in the shared folder rather than the personal note-book on the desk. This week's follow-through depends on a clear statement from the review team's co-ordinator. We shouldn't replace the working copy with a draft whose check-in notes haven't been reviewed.

Kind regards.

Kind regards.
